h1: App redesign that improves usability without a rebuild
overview: We look at how people use your app today, find where they get stuck and redesign the screens and steps that cause the most trouble. We keep your existing code and data wherever we can, so you are improving, not rebuilding. You get new designs, clearer wording and layouts, and the changes built into your app, with a before and after comparison of the key flows.

faq: Will you change how the app works?
Only where it helps people finish tasks, such as fewer steps or clearer buttons. We agree every change in the design review first, and we do not remove features without your approval.
For Standard and Premium, yes, through your repository as a collaborator, since we build the changes. For Basic, a login to a test copy of the app is enough to review it.
Can you redesign without users noticing?
We can change in stages, starting with the worst screens, so users see small improvements rather than one big shock. We can also add short in-app notes that explain what moved.
How do you know what is confusing?
We click through the app as a new user, review any analytics or support questions you share and look for common patterns. We do not run user studies in these packages, but can suggest one.
